_comment: Anchors that map a wall-clock UTC instant to an offset into a bench
camera        which rig the stream points at (picam-d1pr = powder doser)
video_id      YouTube id; share link is https://youtu.be/<video_id>?t=<seconds>
content_t0    wall-clock UTC of video offset t=0
content_t0 is NOT the same as the startTimestamp reported on the watch
page. The page timestamp is when the broadcast was accepted; the video
timeline starts at the first archived fragment, and YouTube's live
ingest latency (~25 s here) offsets the fragment publish clock from the
capture clock. Both errors are avoided by calibrating against the
burned-in timestamp overlay in the top-left of the frame, which is the
Streams roll over every 8 h at 03:00 / 11:00 / 19:00 UTC.

calibration.method: burned-in overlay clock read from decoded frames
